assign_0: SELECT customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE ((order_id = CAST(? AS INT)) AND (status = 'NEW'))
condition_1: SELECT CASE WHEN (CAST(? AS INT) IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
condition_3: SELECT CASE WHEN (CAST(? AS DECIMAL(12,2)) <= 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
assign_5: SELECT loyalty_tier FROM customer WHERE (customer_id = CAST(? AS INT))
assign_6: SELECT points_multiplier FROM loyalty_tier_rule WHERE (tier = CAST(? AS VARCHAR(10)))
assign_7: SELECT CAST(TRUNCATE((CAST(? AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * CAST(? AS DECIMAL(4,2))), 0) AS INT)
dml_9: UPDATE orders SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE (order_id = CAST(? AS INT))
insert_10: INSERT INTO payment (order_id, method, amount, status, paid_at, customer_id, payment_id) VALUES (CAST(? AS INT), CAST(? AS VARCHAR(10)), CAST(? AS DECIMAL(12,2)), 'CAPTURED', LOCALTIMESTAMP, (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_id = CAST(? AS INT)), CAST(? AS INT))
insert_11: INSERT INTO loyalty_txn (customer_id, order_id, points, reason, txn_date, txn_id) VALUES (CAST(? AS INT), CAST(? AS INT), CAST(? AS INT), 'PURCHASE', LOCALTIMESTAMP, CAST(? AS INT))
dml_12: UPDATE customer SET loyalty_points = (loyalty_points + CAST(? AS INT)), updated_at = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE (customer_id = CAST(? AS INT))
